cities.name: Athens
cities.local_food_tip: Gyros, souvlaki, fresh seafood, salads, olives — classic Greek flavors with Mediterranean freshness. 🥗🍢🐟
cities.full_day:
Morning: 🏛️ Visit Acropolis & Parthenon, explore ancient ruins and historic landmarks. → ☕ Coffee and traditional breakfast in old town.

Afternoon: 🚶 Stroll through narrow alleys of Plaka, visit museums or local markets → 🍽️ Lunch: Greek mezze or seafood by a terrace. → 🌇 Walk up to a hilltop viewpoint for city panorama.

Sunset: 🌅 Sunset view over Athens roofs and hills — golden hour over history and modern city. 

Night: 🌙 Dinner in traditional taverna, maybe live music, evening strolls through lively streets — blend of ancient and contemporary Greece.

ideas: 🌼 Pleasant weather for sightseeing and walking ancient sites without summer crowd.
🎨 Outdoor cafés, markets and cultural events as city awakens.
🚶 Exploring old town streets under gentle sun — relaxed pace.
🌞 Early sightseeing, midday rest, then evening strolls or rooftop dinners under warm sky.
🍹 Cold drinks, seafood, ice‑cream and relaxed nights after hot days.
🌇 Sunset walks and late‑night culture under warm summer nights.
🍂 Soft light and pleasant temperature — ideal for photos around ancient sites.
🥘 Hearty meals with Greek flavors and warm hospitality as days cool.
🏺 Indoor museums or cultural visits if weather changes.
🌤️ Mild winter weather — still good for city walks and sightseeing.
🔥 Warm meals, local dishes and cozy taverna dinners after chilly evenings.
🎭 Less crowd — peaceful exploration of historic sites and city corners.

public_transport_tips: 🚇 Use metro and buses to navigate city and reach outskirts easily.
🚶 Old town and central areas walkable — good for sightseeing on foot.
🚲 Bikes or scooters may help for short hops or beachfront promenades.
🎟️ Day‑pass for public transport useful if exploring multiple areas.

🍨 Fresh meals, local drinks and relaxed coastal lifestyle under warm nights.
🍂 Milder temperature, calm sea — pleasant for sightseeing without summer heat.
🥘 Hearty Mediterranean meals after day trips or hikes.
🌅 Stunning sunsets and soft light over seas and islands — perfect for photos.
